name: Circulating fluidized-bed boilers
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. IR-CFB design: U-beam solids collection plus multi-cyclone dust collector, no loop seals, reduced-diameter furnace zone to limit erosion; capacity to 2.2 million lb/h (277 kg/s), pressure to 2,600 psig (17.9 MPa), steam temperature usually to 1,050 F (566 C); 1/10 the refractory mass of a hot-cyclone CFB; staged combustion and SNCR for NOx, limestone for SO2. Evidence: https://www.babcock.com/home/products-services/steam-generators/circulating-fluidized-bed-boilers
